Alyn Goodbrother answers the call with 400 men; they gather at Hammerhorn and march for Winterfell in about 5 days. Torwold Orkwood answers the call with 400 men; they gather at Orkmont and march for Winterfell in about 5 days. Alyn Drumm answers the call with 350 men; they gather at Old Wyk and march for Winterfell in about 5 days. Gysella Blacktyde answers the call with 350 men; they gather at Blacktyde and march for Winterfell in about 5 days. Host of House Harlaw, 1,250 strong, sets out from Ten Towers for Winterfell — by sea. Host of House Harlaw (1,250 men) sails from Ten Towers for the coast…

title: Jon "Greatjon" Umber holds a feast for the household at Last Hearth
text: Jon "Greatjon" Umber holds a feast for the household at Last Hearth.

title: Helman Tallhart rides for The Dreadfort
text: Helman Tallhart leaves Torrhen's Square with 30 knights and riders under the Tallhart banner, for the tourney at The Dreadfort.

title: Guyard Buckler rides for Storm's End
text: Guyard Buckler leaves Bronzegate with 30 knights and riders under the Buckler banner, for the tourney at Storm's End.

title: A full harvest at Gates of the Moon
text: The ironwork harvest around Gates of the Moon is the best in ten years. Nestor's steward is buying new granaries.

title: The Greatjon's table
text: The Greatjon has broken a chair and a cousin's nose at the table of Last Hearth. The feast continued.

title: Alyn Goodbrother rides for Saltcliffe
text: Alyn Goodbrother leaves Hammerhorn with 60 knights and riders under the Goodbrother banner, to hunt in the country near Saltcliffe.

title: The small council sits
text: The small council meets in the council chamber of the Red Keep; petitioners wait in the yard below.

title: House Baratheon of Storm's End holds a tourney at Storm's End; 17 houses send knights.
text: House Baratheon of Storm's End holds a tourney at Storm's End; 17 houses send knights.

title: Ser Loras Tyrell is champion of the tourney at Storm's End.
text: Ser Loras Tyrell is champion of the tourney at Storm's End.

title: Wyman Manderly is not himself
text: Wyman Manderly has the look of a man who has not slept well in some time.
details: Wyman Manderly has the look of a man who has not slept well in some time.

title: Lord Hoster abed
text: Lord Hoster Tully is too ill to leave his bed at Riverrun. The Blackfish runs the castle, and Edmure pretends to.

title: Pirates sighted off Widow's Watch
text: Sails with no banner have been seen off Widow's Watch; the fishing fleet stays in harbour.
details: Sails with no banner have been seen off Widow's Watch; the fishing fleet stays in harbour.

title: Jon "Greatjon" Umber rides for The Dreadfort
text: Jon "Greatjon" Umber leaves Last Hearth with 100 knights and riders under the Umber banner, to feast with Roose Bolton at The Dreadfort.

title: Maege Mormont rides for Deepwood Motte
text: Maege Mormont leaves Bear Island with 70 knights and riders under the Mormont banner, to feast with Galbart Glover at Deepwood Motte.

title: Hoster Tully rides for Stone Hedge
text: Hoster Tully leaves Riverrun with 310 knights and riders under the Tully banner, to settle a border quarrel with Jonos Bracken.

title: House Nymeros Martell calls up 2,944 levies at Sunspear.
